libs.note: BH-3927 (BH-3921 part 5). Moves an in-app ticket on once its newest build's PR passed the post-merge deploy audit: one comment, then a move to done (system-filed) or review (client-filed); a move to review also gives the turn to the client (POST /turn). Called from inapp_released_lines (bin/lib/rt/scope.sh) before the in-app parent close. BH-8786: a ticket with no build dir on this box (built by a peer fleet) takes the peer path: the newest thread comment with a project-repo PR URL, GitHub REST pulls/<n> for merged_at, and the prod version sha (GitHub compare) or, with no version route, MERGED_ADVANCE_DEPLOY_GRACE_S after the merge. Skip reasons in the MERGED_ADVANCE line: no-audit, audit-fail, newer-build, client-spoke, client-review, moved-back, move-gave-up, and on the peer path no-local-build (every peer candidate), no-pr-in-thread, pr-open, deploy-behind, peer-unread (a failed ticket, PR, compare or version read), pr-ambiguous (the newest PR comment names two PRs). Doc: docs/verification-map/board-dependencies.md.

knobs.note: Ticket records one run reads (a GET each, then at most a comment and a move). The rest wait for the next run and the lane logs MERGED_ADVANCE_CAPPED with how many. Read as ${MERGED_ADVANCE_MAX:-10}.
How long a --cooled run (the in-app tick) waits after the last one before reading the board again. A hand run is never held. Read as ${MERGED_ADVANCE_COOLDOWN_S:-600}.

How many runs retry a move that failed (no 2xx echo of the target status) before the lane gives up on that ticket and audit with one MERGED_ADVANCE_GAVE_UP line and one alert. The comment stands; the ticket is moved by hand. 0, a non-number or empty reads 3. Read as ${MERGED_ADVANCE_MOVE_TRIES:-3}.
